Analyst.contrast_definition: From t=0 with matched saved random priors, random streams, checkpoint and native protocol; one registered intervention versus its parent. Chemical graphs remain free; historical suffix score levels are not from-zero treatment effects.
Analyst.falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, under the matched from-zero protocol with only region changed to F_b011_s030__O and operator pointwise, the local pointwise target_error and point_rms_A trajectories over [0.0,0.5] are indistinguishable from the S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY reference run (no measurable region-specific change), or if the O-region run shows no nonzero active updates. It is also weakened if the O-region terminal metrics fall within the parent/outcomes range without any local observable difference, since that would indicate the region change did not act through the proposed local coordinate channel.
Analyst.observable_definition: Implemented and derivative-tested: local Hungarian assignment, robust per-point distance to observed teacher coordinates. Units A; no chemical-role or energy assumption.
Analyst.predicted_execution_response: The pointwise operator will run with the same Hungarian assignment and robust per-point distance, but the local support and target coordinates will be those of F_b011_s030__O. Expect nonzero active updates and a measurable target_error/point_rms_A trajectory over [0.0,0.5]; the parent/response for S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY shows the reference program already produces 40 active and 40 nonzero updates with mean point_rms_A 0.169 and mean target_error 0.169, so the O-region run should be compared against that same-program reference rather than against suffix scores.
Analyst.predicted_terminal_response: Terminal affinity is not forecast here. The parent/outcomes reference gives best_qualified_pic50 8.434, mean_all_pic50 7.827, hit_fraction 0.0417, n_qualified 22 of 24, and U_tau 0.01246; the O-region run may differ, but report/limits states source layout score is not a generated score forecast and no universal Top10 motif survived full feature correction. A terminal gain is therefore neither predicted nor excluded.
Analyst.scientific_hypothesis: Changing only the region from F_b011_s030__reference to F_b011_s030__O while keeping the parent pointwise operator will produce a measurable, region-specific change in the local pointwise target error and point_rms_A over the complete learning window [0.0,0.5], because the O region selects a different local support (atoms 1,16,18,19) and a different set of pocket-site distances than the reference region. This is a geometric hypothesis about local coordinate observables, not a claim that O fields carry established actionable reward: report/O-intervention shows carboxyl O-only torsion interventions were not significant (family_adjusted_p=0.02532, significant_carboxyl_intervention=false) and drop_O_R2=0.2473 with heldout_full_R2=0.3435, so any terminal benefit remains unproven.

Designer.scientific_rationale: Single-factor from-zero contrast: only region_id changes (F_b011_s030__reference -> F_b011_s030__O) and atom_slots changes to the four-atom O support [1,16,18,19]; operator stays pointwise, dose, controller, native_options, steps, window and teacher_time are inherited unchanged from S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY. F_b011_s030__O/regional_context supplies the local support (atoms 1,16,18,19; elements C,O,C,O) and the six pocket sites with source distances; these are direct support for the local direction, not a proven contact or energy. The hypothesis is geometric: a different local support and different pocket-site distance set should change the local pointwise target_error and point_rms_A trajectory over [0.0,0.5]. No affinity claim is made: report/O-intervention shows carboxyl O-only torsion interventions were not significant (family_adjusted_p=0.02532, significant_carboxyl_intervention=false; drop_O_R2=0.2473, heldout_full_R2=0.3435), and report/limits states source layout score is not a generated score forecast and no universal Top10 motif survived full feature correction. F_b011_s030__NO/conditional_layout reports n_identifiable_interactions=0 over 10 measured layouts, so no signed interaction is claimed.
